sources.title: Self-critiquing models for assisting human evaluators — quoted full-text passages (arXiv 2206.05802v2 PDF)

state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper reports that with assistance answers are more frequently critiqued and given lower ratings: on model answers, unassisted labelers found critiques on 54% of inputs with an average rating of 5.6, while assisted labelers found critiques on 78% of inputs with an average rating of 4.9. The authors note the critique model was trained on data from the same labeler pool, so it essentially bootstraps labelers to be more careful.
title: With assistance, model answers are critiqued more often and rated lower
